extraction.Name: John Guerue
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded February 5, 1918 by the Bank of Cody
extraction.Buyer: Mr. Guerue and wife conveyed the land to Irwin C. Stotts for a consideration of $2500.00
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612682 issued; receipt for patent signed by the allottee January 28, 1918; conveyance dated January 30, 1918; land described as the southwest quarter of section 4, township 35, range 32
